statement: A player's own face-down monster can be Tributed, or used as Fusion Material, for what it is: the game reveals it as it is used, and only the word "face-up" asks for more. An opponent's face-down monster shows nothing, so it must be face-up where the effect checks what a face-down monster doesn't show.
scripts: The scripts agree for their own player's monsters (Linkuriboh, Clown Crew Finale, Icarus Attack and ten more). Of the 28 cards where another effect could let a player Tribute the opponent's, 9 scripts ask for face-up (IsControler(tp) or IsFaceup(): Ultra Evolution Pill, Rose Bud, Dragonic Tactics, Release Restraint, Artmage Non-Finito) and 19 don't (Linkuriboh, Icarus Attack).
